proposed.explanation:
Profit attributable to Talaat Moustafa Group's own shareholders (the parent-company line) rose from 9,025,066,065 LE in 2024 (restated) to 14,383,890,306 LE in 2025, an increase of 5,358,824,241 LE or roughly 59.4 %. Total consolidated net profit grew from 12,769,517,325 LE to 18,201,981,482 LE (+42.5 %), and EPS jumped from 4.38 LE to 6.98 LE (+59.4 %). Gross profit and pre-tax profit also expanded by roughly 49 % and 43 % respectively, indicating the growth is broad-based rather than a one-off item. Total equity grew from about 129.9 bn LE to 157.7 bn LE, so the balance sheet is strengthening alongside earnings.

For a long-term growth investor with a 5-10 year horizon and high loss tolerance, this one-year acceleration is encouraging and supports keeping the existing 500-share position. However, I cannot recommend adding to the position for two reasons:

1. Diversification constraint: your 500 TMGH shares are worth 41,250 EGP against 30,000 EGP cash, so TMGH already represents about 58 % of your 71,250 EGP portfolio. The rule that no single holding may exceed half of total portfolio value after a buy means you cannot purchase even one additional TMGH share without breaching the limit.

2. Evidence depth: the figures cover a single fiscal year (FY2025 vs restated FY2024). A 5-10 year growth thesis ideally rests on multi-year trends, revenue visibility, capital-allocation policy, and sector outlook—none of which are in the provided evidence. One strong year is a positive signal but not yet a confirmed multi-year trajectory.

Risks to keep in mind: the 2024 comparatives are restated, so the true year-on-year change may differ from the printed figures; a single-year snapshot does not rule out cyclical peaks; and concentration in one stock amplifies idiosyncratic risk. I would revisit the position after the next annual report to confirm the growth is sustainable before considering any further allocation (which would require first reducing the TMGH weight below 50 % or adding a different holding).
